summary: Resumed from the paused run's E1 (committed pose + the dR1 palm masses) and its planar-finger work, and finished the calibration on the step-3 builder. Every right gate passes on the final state on disk (R7, rebuilt with --views). The verifier's major is fixed: every finger's PIP and DIP bend now lies in that finger's MCP flexion plane, with sideways parts of 4 deg or less (little finger 46/-61 -> 0/0, middle DIP 40.7 -> 3.3). To do this I solved each finger's depths with a small side-bend tolerance and re-fitted its px and r. The thumb is now straight in projection: its IP is a pure 13.5 deg flexion (side 12.6 -> -0.2) and its MCP side bend went from -16 to -7 deg. The thumb CMC is set back to z 0.17 per D22 (home-view fold 74 -> 47 px), with the metacarpal kept at 49 mm. nail_start thumb = 0.22 puts the nail fold at x 950 (drawn 948-951). The palm was thinned with the step-3 controls (meta_base_thick 0.70 with wrist r 59, palm z .04 / flat .17, hypothenar moved from the palmar to the ulnar side, larger FDI and hypothenar masses): mid-palm is now 31-36 mm (was 31-43). Finger sections are rounder (flat .92/.92/.88/.82). This gives the same drawn width and clears the middle-ring and ring-little overlaps. The little finger's distal part is fuller where the reference is wider. The index PIP is at y 474, not the note's 479, because the drawn top line is curved and 474 fits it better. The index's hinge is now in depth (PIP z .115, DIP z .125), and its tip stays at (807,438), z 0.13. dorsal is unchanged: nothing in the new builder or the fixes needed a change. No D-numbers were added after D22.

openIssues: Palm thickness is still above the note's ~30 mm near the wrist. At 0.5 of wrist -> knuckles it is 31-35 mm (was 31-43); at 0.3 it is 29-39 mm, up to 39 mm on the ulnar (hypothenar) side (was 28-42). The limit is the drawn palm band. With this depth reading (dorsal (0.459,0.669,-0.585)), the palm's thickness, not its width, fills the band's height. Every thinner variant dropped the dorsal top edge 15-20 px off the drawing: E3d, palm z .06 + meta .8 + fdi_lift .1, IoU 0.916, mean 4.06, fails gates; mb75, mean +0.27 px in the palm box. Going to ~30 mm would take a new orientation reading (the user's call) or a builder change. I did neither.

The MCP knuckles lie on a nearly straight line, not a convex arch: dorsal offsets index +1.3, middle -2.6, ring 0.0, little +1.2 mm. Arch variants cost 0.25 px mean in the middle/pocket region and left ring-little root voids plus overlaps of -1.1 to -1.8 px (exp-poses/A1.json, A2.json). The current state was kept.

The little finger's MCP flexion is 104 deg (was 105) against the builder's metacarpal frame. The drawing hangs the little finger straight down while the hand axis points up-left. Keeping MCP flexion <= 95 deg forced 30/17 mm phalanges and side bends. The 5th ray's CMC cupping is not modelled in the plate frame.

The middle finger's distal segment (DIP to tip, 27.0 mm) equals its middle phalanx (27.1 mm), P3/P1 0.60. The drawn distal segment is long, 55 px projected. The middle MCP is abducted -13 deg at 53 deg flexion.

Middle/ring pocket (x 905-932, y 605-636): the render leaves a narrow wedge reaching (931,608), while the reference draws a rounder pocket that ends near (915,625). 30 edge px are over 8 px; this is the largest render->ref error, 23.3 px. Root radii did not fix it: w1-w4 gave 0.02 px at most, and w2 made a void.

Contour max 34.5 px is the reference's tail-cut dent at (1322-1325, 692-706), just outside right-ignore.png; reported before. The wrist's r 55 -> 59 moved it from 30.9 to 34.5 px. The max is not gated.

builderRequests: Enclosed sub-voxel voids between digits that almost touch near their roots. The field outside two nearly touching finger roots and the palm can close into a 1-2 voxel pocket. The level set then gets an extra shell and A1 fails. Evidence: scratch builds exp/E3 and exp/E3b failed A1 with 2 shells, a 3-vertex shell at px (966,645), z -0.029 (tools/shells.py). tools/voids.py finds the same pocket in the SDF, and new ones for ring_mcp r 29-30 (w2) and the arch variants A1/A2. Filling enclosed outside components of the grid before extraction (keep only the outside region connected to the grid border) would remove this failure mode. It would also let the pose put the knuckles on a convex arch (openIssues) without chasing voids.

The index MCP knuckle bump cannot go lower than knuckle_rise -0.5, the bottom of its range. The bump still stands 5-7 px above the reference's drawn back line at x 1000-1020 (tools/topline.py: deltas -5/-7/-4 px there). D12 reads that back as straight. A lower bound for knuckle_rise, or a way to shrink the dorsal knuckle ellipsoid itself, would let the pose draw it flat.
